analyst_view.overall: Early view: Getafe have taken all 12 of their points at the Coliseum, where they are unbeaten, but Bordalás says the squad is worn out by the Conference League, and Nemanja Gudelj is suspended. Atlético's run of eight straight wins ended with a 2-1 home defeat to Barcelona, and Cuti Romero has a new muscle injury. Atlético host Viking in the Champions League on Wednesday; Getafe go to Iberia Tbilisi on Thursday.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals and I lean a little lower. Getafe at home shut games down, Atlético conceded only eight in their first ten league games, and the hosts lose Gudelj's experience at the back. A 1-0 or 1-1 type of game is the most likely.

corners.text: The site expects 9.3 corners. Bordalás' sides play long and slow the game down, with lots of throw-ins and free kicks, and Atlético rarely trap opponents in their box away from home. Eight or nine corners seems right.

cards.text: The model has 5.3 cards and I lean higher. Getafe against Atlético under Bordalás and Simeone is usually a scrappy, physical game, and Atlético just took four yellows against Barcelona. Six or more is realistic.

shots.text: The site expects 24.6 shots. Bordalás admitted his tired side was passing poorly at Villarreal, and Getafe have yet to score away from home, so their attack is limited. A broken-up game should keep the total in the low 20s.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.4 on target. With Uche and Juanmi out, Getafe's attack lacks a sharp edge, and Atlético's chances should be few in a tight game. About six on target seems right.
